---
name: 💡 Feature Request
about: Suggest an idea for this project
title: '[FEATURE] '
labels: 'enhancement'
assignees: ''

---

## 💡 Feature Description
<!-- A clear and concise description of the feature you'd like to see implemented. -->

## 🎯 Problem Statement
<!-- What problem does this feature solve? Why is it needed? -->

## 💭 Proposed Solution
<!-- How do you envision this feature working? Be as detailed as possible. -->

## 🔄 Alternatives Considered
<!-- What other approaches have you considered? Why did you choose this approach? -->

## 📱 Use Cases
<!-- How would this feature be used? Provide specific examples. -->

## 🎨 UI/UX Considerations
<!-- If this involves UI changes, describe the user interface design. -->

## 🔧 Technical Implementation
<!-- Any thoughts on how this should be implemented technically? -->

## 📊 Impact Assessment
<!-- How many users would benefit from this feature? -->
<!-- What would be the impact on performance, battery life, etc.? -->

## 📋 Additional Context
<!-- Add any other context, screenshots, or mockups about the feature request here. -->

## 🏷️ Tags
<!-- Add relevant tags (comma separated): -->
<!-- e.g., gui, bluetooth, performance, security, apps -->

## ✅ Checklist
<!-- Please check the boxes that apply: -->
- [ ] I've searched existing issues for similar requests
- [ ] I've checked that this is not a duplicate feature request
- [ ] I've considered whether this feature benefits the majority of users
- [ ] I'm willing to help implement this feature
- [ ] I've provided sufficient detail for developers to understand the request

## 🤝 Willing to Contribute?
<!-- Let us know if you're interested in helping implement this feature. -->
- [ ] Yes, I can write the code
- [ ] Yes, I can help with testing
- [ ] Yes, I can help with documentation
- [ ] No, but I'd be happy to test it when implemented
